name: Takase Ryuuji
source:
Transferred to his new school a year ago. A so-called "ordinary" male student. So ordinary, in fact, that there seems to be nothing interesting about him at all. Others around him have noticed this.
He turns to things like movies, novels, and manga to get stimulation from something.

Although he's the leader of his school's newspaper club, they haven't gotten any work done at all. His teacher, who couldn't stand this inactivity any longer, pushed him to gather members to report local ghost stories.

After this, he and his clubmates began gathering info for their article on the town's Seven Wonders...

[translated from getchu]
